messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — we want to run a cross-site cutover test tomorrow 03:00 UTC for active/active routing with EU residency enforcement. I want a short safety checklist and any last-minute guards we should enable.

matt: +1. Main risk areas: lease swap ordering, KV ownership during handoff, and clients seeing mixed-region writes.

devon: Agree. Proposal: canary 1% tenants, shadow writes to target region (no commit), then do lease token exchange, then flip. Keeps rollback simple.

sarah: For residents with strict residency, we need an explicit consent flag so we never write outside EU. Are we still honoring tenant.residency = "eu" in the router?

anya: yes router honors tenant.residency. Canary will only include tenants without residency constraints. We'll test residency-path separately with dry-run.

kevin: Practical check: prewarm KV caches in target region and ensure prefix KVs are warmed. Cold-starts cause long tail SLOs. Also ensure per-region quota mappings are correct.

devon: Also add a handshake: source returns a lease_transfer_token, target validates via control-plane API, then source marks lease as TRANSFERRING, then target marks OWNED when ready. If transfer fails, source reverts to OWNED.

anya: Can we set a quarantine TTL on transferred leases (e.g., 5m) to avoid double-writes during flapping?

matt: +1 quarantine TTL=5m. Add metric leak detection: if a lease toggles more than 3 times in TTL window, auto-abort rollout for that tenant.

kevin: Need to update rollback playbook: immediate re-route to previous region + invalidate short-lived cache entries (prefix+session) with a tombstone key. Example CLI: 
```
redwoodctl region-rollback --tenant $TID --from eu-west --to us-east --tombstone-prefix session:$TID --force
```

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: routing-proxy v2.14 -> canary at 02:45 UTC, auto-rollback on healthcheck fail.

anya: Good. Two open questions: 1) consented EU tenants — want dry-run vs full cutover? 2) operator ergonomics for aborts (one-button rollback in Console?).

sarah: For consented EU tenants do dry-run only tomorrow. We need legal signoff for full cutover.

devon: We can add a Console abort button that triggers the CLI rollback flow + notifies oncall channel. Easy enough as a temporary runbook.

oncall-bot: oncall notified: @oncall-sre scheduled for 03:00 UTC. If healthchecks fail, page escalation policy "cross-region-cutover" will trigger.

anya: Thanks team — action items:
- devon: implement lease_transfer_token + quarantine TTL (PR by EOD)
- kevin: prewarm script + tombstone CLI docs
- sarah/legal: confirm dry-run policy for EU tenants
- matt/ops: create Console abort button spec
We meet 02:30 UTC for readiness check. :thumbsup:
